name: @hobo/provider-convex

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hobo/core build && pnpm --filter @hobo/sdk build && tsc -p tsconfig.json

description: HoBo Convex deploy-target CloudProvider: reactive TypeScript BaaS (Cloud or self-host) behind agnostic ports with honest-partial capability verdicts, typed impedance limits, SDK defineResource adapters, and credential-gated deploy/apply (ADR-0144).
